title: Rebase local fork commits onto upstream main
objective: Update this fork from the main upstream repository and rebase the local commits on top of the latest upstream main, without pushing or opening a PR.
instructions: Inspect remotes, current branch, ahead/behind state, and working tree status before changing anything.
Identify the main upstream repository remote and branch. If ambiguous, stop and return a blocked ResultPacket with the remotes and recommendation.
Fetch the upstream/main repo and rebase the current local branch's local commits onto the latest upstream main.
Preserve existing dirty working tree changes. If needed, use a reversible stash/autostash and report the stash reference/status; do not discard user changes.
If conflicts occur, stop at the conflict state only if necessary and return exact conflicted files plus suggested resolution order; do not guess through risky conflicts.
After a successful rebase, restore any preserved working tree changes and report final branch/ahead-behind status.
constraints: Do not push to any remote.
Do not create new product commits beyond the rebase operation itself.
Do not reset --hard, clean, or discard uncommitted changes.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket summarizing remotes, fetched upstream target, rebase result, conflicts if any, final status, and whether any stash remains.
definition_of_done: Local branch is rebased onto upstream main or the task is blocked with precise conflict/ambiguity details; no push or PR occurred.
